title: 3D Role Models — Фразы: рассказ о вдохновляющем человеке

items.example: Someone who influenced me greatly is my first coach.
I'd describe him as kind and patient.
Some say he's strict, but I see him as fair.
She inspired me by her courage.
He inspired me to study medicine.
The main thing she taught me was honesty.
Parents should set a good example for children.
She overcame the difficulties of her background.
She taught me to change my goal if it can't be achieved.
His father gives the family a lot of support.
His parents were there for him when problems appeared.
Money problems got in his way, but he continued.
Good mentors push us to be better all the time.
My teacher helped me a lot to get into university.
Write a biography of someone who inspires you.
Which description is most similar to yours?
Note down one characteristic each person gives.
